notes.note: #0.71-85 leader block: 0640.bla checks Pt_Chara_Check 8,9,10,6,7,13,12,11,15,14,3,1,5,4 before n=70,77,76,78..84,75,74,73,72, so #0.81 Taro, #0.82 Seven, #0.83 Ultraman, #0.84 Zero (cocky 'bust 'em up' line fits), #0.85 Mebius. Extractor's 'W (Shotaro)' label is the carried-over name. Identical JP -> identical EN.
Master Gundam's contemptuous 'domo' rendered 'You Lost Hero rabble'.
#0.89-102 are 14 identical copies of #0.88 'Wait!!' (W). The script only shows n=87 (#0.88); the copies are unreferenced leftovers, translated identically.
God Gundam (Domon) wants to chase Master Gundam; Ankh (#0.106) pulls the team back to the operation set up in story_119 (heading to the high-energy reading marked on the map).
Black RX, shown only if RX is in the party (Pt_Chara_Check 2). Subject restored as 'That' (the fight/foe); kept gender-neutral wording though Jark Midora is g=m.

0641/0642 leader blocks use chain 8,9,10,6,7,15,14,13,12,11,5,4,3,2,1 = God, Wing Zero, 00, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1. k=0 God has the distinct line; k=12 (#0.14, #0.17, #0.34) are Momotaros' rough variants. 0641 block runs #0.2-15 here (one slot short of 15; text identical so order is moot).
Ankh (speaker 36): 'koitsu wa, Devil Gundam' read as recognition after God Gundam names it: 'So this thing is the Devil Gundam!!'.
God Gundam (k=0) names the Devil Gundam; the 'na no ka!!' realisation is rendered as an exclaimed question, since Master Gundam immediately rebuts it in #0.37.
seitai yunitto = Life Core (glossary). Subject 'it' = Devil Gundam.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped from 0640/0641/0642.bla Pt_Chara_Check chains. #0.89-102 are unreferenced copies of 'Wait!!'. No new names or terms.
